title: 第九回 驭音之术第十回 坑遇故人
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第九回驭音之术
爷爷获救，应老君之请，孤鹤雁不能拒绝，于是便和爷爷在慕府小住了两日。
这两日，孤鹤雁与慕卉云相处甚欢，两个人年岁相当，心灵相通，话题不断，相处得很开心很合意。
很多时候两个人在一起，说着说着就是一阵放声爽朗大笑，给这死寂的幕府带来很多春意！
老君看在眼里，喜在心头。
且说这一日，两个人在幕府花园中游玩，谈笑风生，说到妙处，又皆相视，发出一阵爽朗的大笑。
慕府老君恰逢经过，听到笑声，不禁心中泛起一丝好奇，便上前询问。
孤鹤雁躬身一礼道：“回老君，方才，姐姐让喜鹊帮她取掉在水中的手绢，我好奇姐姐如何能让喜鹊听得懂使唤，便想学。”
“姐姐便说，想学可以，但得拜师。”
“我说拜师是自然。”
“姐姐便问，那你是想让我当你师父，还是当你师娘？”
慕府老君闻听，不禁莞尔一笑，她瞥一眼慕卉云道：“这个疯丫头，说话没个正经！”
“你要学，确实可以让卉云教你。”
“不过，这是一项灵力，非等闲之辈能学，亦非寻常之辈能及。”
孤鹤雁闻听道：“确实如此。”
慕府老君道：“不过，以你的禀赋，学这个谅也不难。”
“只是，这项灵俢，我们向来只传内，不传外，你可曾知道？”
孤鹤雁闻听，恭恭敬敬道：“仙法与灵技，莫不如此。”
“一要看个人，二要看良师。”
慕府老君闻听，不禁赞许的点点头，她随即把眼看向慕卉云：“听到吗，丫头，学着点，这叫求知！”
“真正有灵修的人，处处透着求知与学问，不会会点三脚猫，就到处拿出去卖弄，那只会让人笑话。”
慕卉云憋住笑，看看孤鹤雁道：“看到吗，弟弟，学着点。”
“什么叫为师，出口便是训诫，三言便是规矩。”
慕府老君闻听，又好气又好笑，不禁抬起手中团扇，作势欲教育状，慕卉云呵呵一笑站到一边，慕府老君转向孤鹤雁：“你已是我慕府一员，这个传你，自然也是必要该当的。”
“至少以后，若需寻你，便遣喜鹊去，也是方便。”
“此术，凭借声音之力，召唤鸟兽与神灵，我且称之为‘驭音之术’。”
“驭音之能，犹如爬梯，从能力上说，可以分为五重。”
“第一重，知音；第二重，传音；第三重，拟音；第四重，魔音；第五重，幻音。”
“知音，就是分辨和识别声音，为自己所用，这个只需用心观察，细心聆听即可；传音，就是将自己的声音，赋能传声出去，这个就需要有一些个人灵力，能让听者闻之懂之；拟音，则是模拟对象的声音，达到控制并为我所用；魔音，就是在声音中加入魔力，令听者心幻，闻听则从；幻音，是驭音术的最高境界，就是通过千奇万化、虚幻至极的声音，召请神灵、召唤鬼魂。”
“不过说来，我的驭音术也只修炼到两重。”
“学成多少，全看你的造化与修为。”
孤鹤雁不愧是灵俢之人，他初学驭音术，便如读书识字一般，一点就通，一学就会，进展神速。
孤鹤雁不满足于仅在幕府召唤喜鹊，便想到外面试上一试。
慕卉云图得开心，冒着阴魄亏损的风险，与他一起到幕府外，驭音比试。
石溪岸边，美人蕉上，一只翠鸟驻枝停留，不停发出清脆的鸣叫，那声音清脆悦耳，如翠珠落盘，慕卉云便指着那只翠鸟，试探孤鹤雁。
“你能听出那只翠鸟声音中的玄机吗？”

Chapter 9: The Art of Controlling Sound
Grandpa was rescued. At Laojun's request, Gu Heyan couldn't refuse, so he and his grandfather stayed in Mu Mansion for two days.
In the past two days, Gu Heyan and Mu Huiyun got along very happily. The two were about the same age, had a close connection, and had constant topics of conversation. They were very happy and agreeable with each other.
Many times when the two of them are together, they laugh heartily while talking, bringing a lot of spring to this dead shogunate!
Laojun saw it and was happy in his heart.
Let's say that on this day, two people were playing in the shogunate garden, chatting and laughing. When they talked about the wonderful things, they both looked at each other and burst into hearty laughter.
Mr. Mu Mansion happened to be passing by. When he heard the laughter, he couldn't help but feel curious, so he stepped forward to ask.
Gu Heyan bowed and said: "Back to Laojun, just now, my sister asked the magpie to help her take away the handkerchief that was dropped in the water. I am curious about how my sister can make the magpie understand the commands, so I want to learn."
"My sister said that if you want to learn, you can, but you have to become a teacher."
"I said it's natural to become a disciple."
"My sister then asked, do you want me to be your master or your mistress?"
Upon hearing this, Mr. Mu Mansion couldn't help but smile. She glanced at Mu Huiyun and said, "This crazy girl doesn't speak seriously!"
"If you want to learn, you can really let Huiyun teach you."
"However, this is a spiritual power that cannot be learned by ordinary people, nor can it be achieved by ordinary people."
Gu Heyan heard this and said, "That's true."
Mr. Mu Mansion said: "However, with your talent, it is not difficult to learn this lesson."
"It's just that we only pass on this spiritual treasure to the inside, not to the outside world. Did you know?"
Gu Heyan heard this and said respectfully: "Immortal magic and spiritual skills are all like this."
"First, it depends on the individual, and second, it depends on the mentor."
After hearing this, Mr. Mu Manor couldn't help but nodded in approval, and then she looked at Mu Huiyun: "Do you hear that, girl, learn from it, this is called seeking knowledge!"
"A truly spiritual person is always seeking knowledge and learning. He will not show off his knowledge of a three-legged cat. That will only make people laugh."
Mu Huiyun suppressed her laughter, looked at Gu Heyan and said, "See, brother, learn from it."
"What does it mean to be a teacher? The words you speak are the admonitions, and the three words are the rules."
After hearing this, Mr. Mufu was both angry and amused. He couldn't help but raise the fan in his hand, as if he wanted to educate him. Mu Huiyun chuckled and stood aside. Mr. Mufu turned to Gu Heyan and said, "You are already a member of my Mufu. It is natural that this message should be passed on to you."
"At least in the future, if I need to find you, it will be convenient to send magpies there."
"This technique relies on the power of sound to summon birds, beasts and gods. I call it the 'sound control technique'."
"The ability to control sounds is like climbing a ladder. In terms of ability, it can be divided into five levels."
"The first level is the intimate sound; the second level is the sound transmission; the third level is the foley sound; the fourth level is the magic sound; the fifth level is the phantom sound."
"Zhiyin means distinguishing and identifying sounds for your own use. This only requires careful observation and listening. Sound transmission means empowering your own voice to be transmitted. This requires some personal spiritual power to allow the listener to hear and understand it. Foley is imitation. The sound of the simulated object can be controlled and used by me; the magic sound is to add magic power to the sound to make the listener's mind wander, and he will follow it; the phantom sound is the highest state of sound control, which is to summon gods and ghosts through thousands of strange and extremely illusory sounds."
"But speaking of which, I have only mastered the art of controlling sound to level two."
"How much you learn depends entirely on your luck and cultivation."
Gu Heyan is worthy of being a spiritual person. When he first learned the art of controlling music, it was like reading and literacy.
Gu Heyan was not satisfied with just summoning magpies in the shogunate, so he wanted to give it a try outside.
Mu Huiyun was so happy that she went with him outside the shogunate to compete in music control at the risk of losing money.
On the bank of the rocky stream, on a canna tree, a kingfisher stayed on a branch and kept making crisp calls. The sound was as clear and sweet as green beads falling on a plate. Mu Huiyun pointed at the kingfisher to test the solitary crane goose.
"Can you hear the secret in that kingfisher's voice?"
